measured_process_usage.clock_scope: Unix timestamps bracket the batch and CPU samples for observation alignment only; wall-clock adjustments may affect them. Latency uses the existing monotonic perf_counter interval. No per-request CPU attribution is implied.
measured_process_usage.scope: Process user/kernel deltas for the whole process and all its threads around the measured batch, including executor creation/join and host driver work. Excludes startup, warmups, readiness wait and later snapshot/hash/NBT validation work. GPU device execution and other processes are not CPU time here. Context-switch/fault counts are platform-reported observations, not wait durations. Average scheduled cores is CPU seconds divided by elapsed batch seconds, not worker occupancy or an elapsed-time share.

Context-switch/fault counts are platform-reported observations, not wait durations. Average scheduled cores is CPU seconds divided by elapsed batch seconds, not worker occupancy or an elapsed-time share.

foreground_probes.gpu_sample_counter_scope: Legacy pipeline.completed counts completed terrain/query samples; a sample can require multiple physical submissions. CPU/constant shortcuts may have zero. This never gates generation.
foreground_probes.scope: Uncached remote-coordinate stress workload. Exact same-backend biome values checked against batched answer reference; idle small-call and concurrent small-call values also verify batch-shape invariance. Same query thread is warmed before measurement. One foreground call at a time with think time after completion; request count varies with region duration. Latency includes native call/queue, excludes result comparison. Reference setup is separate from idle latency; both precede every measured native delta. Region completion/CPU window excludes foreground drain tail; native timing/profile snapshots and optional GPU interval end after drain. Not a player/FPS/Java workload. Reservoir sampling is deterministic and bounded; all answers remain checked.

measured_process_usage.clock_scope: Unix timestamps bracket the batch and CPU samples for observation alignment only; wall-clock adjustments may affect them. Latency uses the existing monotonic perf_counter interval. No per-request CPU attribution is implied.
